description: checkHostAvailability: Check if a host/glue record name is available for creation. Requires authentication. Returns whether the hostname is free; call before createHost.

hostname.description: Fully qualified host name to check, e.g. 'ns1.example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: checkHostAvailability
